Fidelity pass round 2, 9824fd5 (range 94a177d5..9824fd56): The Glasshouse is a declared roofed interior: no rain or snow inside and people inside close umbrellas; skyline culling of the city context.
Fidelity pass round 3, 2b1a251 (range 9824fd56..2b1a2511): Shared Seattle Center scene: International Fountain, Olympic Iliad, Climate Pledge Arena and the monorail station canopy.
